known_tool_defect: lookup_article_by_citation returns pmid and key TRANSPOSED — the real PMID arrives in the field labelled 'key'. This lane avoided that tool entirely and resolved by search_articles + get_article_metadata with TITLE READ-BACK on every identifier asserted as verified this pass.
identifier_rule: verified_by=citation-lookup means resolved THIS pass by search with title read-back. verified_by=NOT-VERIFIED means either inherited from a prior E156 lane without re-verification, or no record resolved and none is asserted. A null identifier is a correct answer; a wrong PMID is a defect.
